source_refs.note: Exercise 12.2, Question 6: find k for continuity at x = 2 (book p.234; printed 'continuous x = 2' without 'at'). Answer key PDF 310: k = 1/6.

blocks.prompt: 6 \[f(x) = \begin{cases} \dfrac{\sqrt{2x + 5} - \sqrt{x + 7}}{x - 2}, & x \ne 2 \\ k, & x = 2 \end{cases}\]Find the value of \(k\) so that \(f\) is continuous at \(x = 2\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh "constant find karo" wala continuity ka sawal hai, aur \(x = 2\) rakhne par \(\frac{0}{0}\) form ban jati hai.
Continuity ke liye \(f(2) = k\) ko \(\lim_{x \to 2} f(x)\) ke barabar hona chahiye. Yani asal kaam limit nikalna hai.
Square roots ka farq ho to us ka ilaaj rationalise (conjugate se multiply) karna hai.
Plan: numerator rationalise karein, \(x - 2\) cancel karein, value rakhein, aur \(k\) ko us ke barabar rakhein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(x \ne 2\) ke liye \(f(x) = \dfrac{\sqrt{2x + 5} - \sqrt{x + 7}}{x - 2}\), aur \(f(2) = k\).
Humein find karna hai: \(k\), taake \(f\) point \(x = 2\) par continuous ho.
Tareeqa: \(k = \lim_{x \to 2} f(x)\). Seedha \(x = 2\) rakhne se \(\frac{0}{0}\) aata hai, is liye conjugate (jora, beech ka sign ulta) se multiply kar ke \(x - 2\) ka factor nikalna hoga.

\(\frac{0}{0}\) form dekhein
\[\sqrt{2(2) + 5} - \sqrt{2 + 7} = 3 - 3 = 0\]
\[x - 2 = 0\]
Kyun: Upar bhi zero, neeche bhi zero. \(\frac{0}{0}\) koi number nahi, "abhi faisla nahi hua" wali halat hai; pehle simplify karna parta hai.

Conjugate se multiply karein
\[f(x) = \frac{\sqrt{2x + 5} - \sqrt{x + 7}}{x - 2}\]
\[\times \frac{\sqrt{2x + 5} + \sqrt{x + 7}}{\sqrt{2x + 5} + \sqrt{x + 7}}\]
Kyun: Formula \((a - b)(a + b) = a^2 - b^2\) square roots ko khatam kar deta hai. Upar neeche ek hi cheez se multiply kiya, is liye fraction ki value nahi badli (yeh 1 se multiply karne jaisa hai).

Numerator simplify karein
\[(2x + 5) - (x + 7) = x - 2\]
\[f(x) = \frac{x - 2}{(x - 2)(\sqrt{2x + 5} + \sqrt{x + 7})}\]
Kyun: \((\sqrt{2x + 5})^2 = 2x + 5\) aur \((\sqrt{x + 7})^2 = x + 7\). Phir \(2x - x = x\) aur \(5 - 7 = -2\).
Dhyan dein: \(-(x + 7)\) mein minus dono terms par lagta hai: \(-x - 7\). Isi jagah aksar sign ki ghalti hoti hai.

\(x - 2\) cancel karein
\[f(x) = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2x + 5} + \sqrt{x + 7}}\]
Kyun: Limit mein \(x\) sirf 2 ke qareeb jata hai, 2 ke barabar nahi hota, is liye \(x - 2 \ne 0\) aur cancel karna jaiz hai. Yahi woh factor tha jo \(\frac{0}{0}\) bana raha tha.

Limit lein
\[\lim_{x \to 2} f(x) = \frac{1}{\sqrt{9} + \sqrt{9}}\]
\[= \frac{1}{3 + 3} = \frac{1}{6}\]
Kyun: Ab denominator 2 par zero nahi (6 hai), is liye seedha value rakh sakte hain.

\(k\) chunein
\[k = f(2) = \lim_{x \to 2} f(x) = \frac{1}{6}\]
Kyun: Continuity ki teesri shart: point par value limit ke barabar ho. Is liye \(k = \frac{1}{6}\).

Tasdeeq
\[f(2.01) = \frac{\sqrt{9.02} - \sqrt{9.01}}{0.01}\]
\[\approx \frac{3.003332 - 3.001666}{0.01} \approx 0.1666\]
Kyun: 2 ke bilkul qareeb function ki value taqreeban 0.1666 hai, jo \(\frac{1}{6} \approx 0.1667\) ke barabar hai. Jawab sahi hai.

blocks.text: Sawal 6 ke saath chhape graph mein \(x\)-axis ke manfi (negative) labels 4, 3, 2, 1 chhape hain, minus ke baghair. Sahi labels \(-4, -3, -2, -1\) hain, jaisa hamari drawing mein hai. Yeh graph Sawal 6 (ya 7) ka function bhi nahin dikhata: is mein \(-2 \le x < 0\) par \(y = 2x + 1\) aur \(0 \le x \le 2\) par \(y = x^{2} - 1\) bana hai. Sawal apne formula se hi hal hota hai.
